title: Mike Masters' abductees sanitize before boarding craft (time-traveller theory)

tellings.quote: In fact, in many cases Mike Masters studied, the abductees had to sanitize themselves, shower or do chemical rinses before boarding the alien craft.

plain: In many abduction cases studied by a researcher named Mike Masters, the abductees had to clean themselves by showering or doing chemical rinses before they were taken onto the alien craft. Michels repeats this from Masters' work, which supports Masters' idea that the visitors are time travellers from our own future, careful about contamination.
